shortDescription: Xuan Changneng, China’s deputy central bank governor, called for greater private-sector participation in sovereign debt restructuring as rising borrowing costs add to developing countries’ debt-servicing burdens, according to Bloomberg.

title: PBOC Deputy Calls for Greater Private Involvement in Sovereign Debt Restructuring
